disclaimer_zh: 下列主体均为未来职责接口，不代表任何机构已经授权、任命、出资或承诺实施。每个试点只有在一个合法授权的Accountable主体实名签署后才能进入现场基线。
disclaimer_en: These are future role interfaces, not appointments, funding or implementation commitments. A pilot may enter a field baseline only after one legally authorised Accountable organisation signs.

positive and negative results, uncertainty and exit decision

common_gates.name_zh: 数据、隐私与内容权利门

minimum_evidence: exit owner and lifecycle cost status

separation_rules: The proposer cannot be the sole evaluator.
The operator cannot unilaterally approve expansion.
The AI component cannot close a work order, approve an engineering option or certify its own result.
A safety, maintenance, data-rights or accessibility role may pause the relevant pilot.
Unassigned role slots remain null; role language must not imply organisational consent.

pilots.title_zh: 13号线知春路—大钟寺可达性审计
pilots.accountable_role_slot: future authorised owner of the public-realm/access-improvement decision
pilots.independent_reviewer_role: accessibility and transport reviewer independent of proposer/operator
permit_dependencies: official entrance/redline/level data before engineering study
rail, traffic, park and safety review
pilots.acceptance_rule: Proceed beyond baseline only if task evidence is verified, non-digital access remains available, no subgroup worsens and G1-G4 are signed.
pilots.stop_rule: Stop collection or intervention after a safety incident, unapproved tracking, inaccessible fallback, missing Accountable owner or professional gate failure.

pilots.title_zh: 清华园场所声景与口述史升级
pilots.acceptance_rule: Proceed only when all published content is cleared, manual/off controls work, accessible interpretation is available and measured disturbance is reviewable under G1-G4.
pilots.stop_rule: Stop the relevant content or playback after rights withdrawal, unverified history, uncontrolled disturbance, failed off control or absent maintainer.

pilots.acceptance_rule: Proceed only when every in-scope critical asset has an owner, fallback, pause path and retirement route and when G1-G4 are signed.
pilots.stop_rule: Pause after privacy, safety, noise, ecology, offline-service or takeover failure; retire the digital layer if responsibility or maintainability cannot be restored.
